name: Sepang International Circuit
description: Sepang in Malaysia. Wide and fast, with two long straights joined by a hairpin. Hot and humid, with storms in the afternoon.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (481 of 2216 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
